ArtRoot.Name: Art folder
ArtRoot.Hint: Folder holding one subfolder per character (portrait.webp, expressions/ and manifest.json). Wayfinder Chronicles: wayfinder-environment/portraits/

SafetyBackground.Name: Safety-net background
SafetyBackground.Hint: Set once as the scene's own background when a scene becomes a stage, and used as its first background. Players still see it if the module fails.

GroupFolders.Name: Group background folders
GroupFolders.Hint: A folder every group finds its backgrounds in by itself, when it exists. {group} stands for the group's name, for example strahd/scenes/{group}/. Leave blank for none. The Wayfinder Chronicles module adds each scenario's scene art without this.
